facts.fact: RET provides public metro/tram/bus connections; current detailed routes should be checked with the operator.
facts.excerpt: Rotterdam beschikt over een uitstekend openbaar vervoersnetwerk, verzorgd door de RET.

facts.fact: OVpay contactless payment is an available option, not a guaranteed cheapest pass.
facts.excerpt: Je betaalt contactloos met je betaalpas, creditcard of mobiele telefoon via OVpay

facts.fact: Water transport operators and conditions are separate; officialinformation describes a water-taxi reservation system.
facts.excerpt: Via de app, website of per telefoon kun je een reservering maken.

facts.fact: Official routing information explicitly includes diversions and roadworks, supporting checks before departure.
facts.excerpt: Op deze pagina word je ook op de hoogte gehouden over omleidingen en werkzaamheden in het Rotterdamse verkeer.

readScope: Substantive destination, admission, access or transport context actually read; source fetch alone was not treated as consultation. No volatile tariffs or schedules asserted in article.
